en: The Gym's been locked for years. Its Leader is off somewhere, and nobody knows when he'll be back.
I've walked these streets every morning since I was a boy. Viridian never changes much, and I like it that way.
Route 22 leads west to the League's gate. Only the strongest trainers come back that way.
There's a forest north of Route 2, full of Bug Pokémon. I'm too scared to go in alone.

Viridian City
The eternally green paradise.

Viridian City Pokémon Gym
The doors are locked.

Trainer Tips
A Pokémon that is asleep or paralysed is easier to catch.

Trainer House
The club for trainers who want a challenge.
